senses.gloss: m., pl. אִיזְגָּרִין (גרר, v. אֵגוֹר; prefix איז׳, cmp. אִיזְמֵל a. אִיזְגַּד) mounds.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74">Gen. R. s. 74</cite> <he>בחקל דאית ביה א׳ וכ׳</he> in a field in which there are mounds (behind which people may hide) talk no secrets. [Muss. incorr. <cite ref="D00000"><he>ד</he></cite> for <cite ref="T00000"><he>ר</he></cite>.]
